chunks: And Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام said:
"Do not enter the bathhouse on an empty stomach, and do not enter it until you have eaten something."

key_terms.شَيْئًا: something, a small amount of food
key_terms.عَلَى الرِّيقِ: on an empty stomach, before eating

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa ibn Ja'far al-Kazim عليه السلام teach about entering the bathhouse?
ai.summary: This hadith gives guidance on proper etiquette when entering the bathhouse. It instructs that one should not enter while fasting from food or on an empty stomach, but rather after eating something, indicating concern for bodily well-being and proper conduct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.245 - Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) said:
'Do not enter the bathhouse on an empty stomach, and do not enter it until you have eaten something.'
